== Biography ==
Rachel was born in 1803. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-563|William Glasgow]] and [[Montgomery-6593|Rhoda Montgomery]].  She passed away about 1848. 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of the descendants of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] identifies '''Rachel Ramsey Glasgow''' in the family of [[Glasgow-563|William Glasgow]] and [[Montgomery-6593|Rhoda Neely Montgomery]]. This family reconstruction agrees with the household and migration evidence summarized on William's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.
